H5329: properly, to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent (as a superintendent, especially of the Temple services and its music); to be permanent
H5058: properly, instrumental music; by implication, a stringed instrument; by extension, a poem set to music; specifically, an epigram
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H4210: properly, instrumental music; by implication, a poem set to notes
H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H408: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing
H639: properly, the nose or nostril; hence, the face, and occasionally a person; also (from the rapid breathing in passion) ire
H3198: to be right (i.e. correct); reciprocal, to argue; causatively, to decide, justify or convict
H2534: heat; figuratively, anger, poison (from its fever)
H3256: to chastise, literally (with blows) or figuratively (with words); hence, to instruct
H2603: properly, to bend or stoop in kindness to an inferior; to favor, bestow; causatively to implore (i.e. move to favor by petition)
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H7495: properly, to mend (by stitching), i.e. (figuratively) to cure
H926: to tremble inwardly (or palpitate), i.e. (figuratively) be (causative, make) (suddenly) alarmed or agitated; by implication to hasten anxiously
H6106: a bone (as strong); by extension, the body; figuratively, the substance, i.e. (as pron.) selfsame
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H3966: properly, vehemence, i.e. (with or without preposition) vehemently; by implication, wholly, speedily, etc. (often with other words as an intensive or superlative; especially when repeated)
H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H5704: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
H4970: properly, extent (of time); but used only adverbially (especially with other particle prefixes), when (either relative or interrogative)
H7725: to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again
H2502: to pull off; hence (intensively) to strip, (reflex.) to depart; by implication, to deliver, equip (for fight); present, strengthen

H2617: kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty
H369: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
H4194: death (natural or violent); concretely, the dead, their place or state (hades); figuratively, pestilence, ruin
H2143: a memento, abstractly recollection (rarely if ever); by implication, commemoration
H7585: Hades or the world of the dead (as if a subterranean retreat), including its accessories and inmates
H4310: who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix
H3034: physically, to throw (a stone, an arrow) at or away; especially to revere or worship (with extended hands); intensively, to bemoan (by wringing the hands)
H3021: properly, to gasp; hence, to be exhausted, to tire, to toil
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H3915: properly, a twist (away of the light), i.e. night; figuratively, adversity
H4296: a bed (as extended) forsleeping or eating; by analogy, a sofa, litter or bier
H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
H6275: to remove (intransitive or transitive) figuratively, to grow old; specifically, to transcribe
H6887: to cramp, literally or figuratively, transitive or intransitive
H4480: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
H6466: to do or make (systematically and habitually), especially to practise

H8085: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)
H1065: a weeping; by analogy, a dripping
H8605: intercession, supplication; by implication, a hymn
H3947: to take (in the widest variety of applications)
H954: properly, to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed; also (by implication) to be disappointed or delayed
H7281: a wink (of the eyes), i.e. a very short space of time
